work.description: CCXCIII Qui psalmos: complete seven-clause SantEustachio brief, all choral-foundation history, every named chapel/benefice, mass burden and amount, deferred suppression, new Piccolomini canonry and additional choral benefit, Massucci nomination, precedence/vote/appointment-turn and execution conditions, full validation, derogation and datum LF58483–58487. Exact XML leaves439–441 normal substantive order; every financial allocation retained. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
